note.title: Healthy living and lifestyle
note.specFocus: Healthy and unhealthy eating, exercise, sleep, stress, smoking and alcohol, physical and mental health, illness, medical appointments, and healthier choices.
note.sourcePages: Original GCSE Spanish revision material; it is not an official AQA paper, mark scheme, or copied publisher content.
note.summary:
Healthy living and lifestyle

Key vocabulary
- la dieta equilibrada; la comida basura; las verduras; evitar; estar en forma; hacer ejercicio; dormir; el estrés; fumar; el tabaco; me duele; tener fiebre; la receta; sanar; saludable; adelgazar; la obesidad

Key grammar
- Use me duele(n) + body part, deber/tener que/hay que for advice, the imperfect for old habits, and the preterite for a completed illness or incident. Use the conditional for recommended changes.

Exam tips
- Check whether a time phrase describes a routine or a finished event. If you use a modal recommendation, keep the next verb in the infinitive.

questions.examTip: Build a short description, an opinion with porque and a personal or hypothetical comment.
questions.modelAnswer:
En la foto se ven unos jóvenes que preparan una ensalada colorida en una cocina. Las personas parecen concentradas y de buen humor. A mi parecer, esta situación es positiva porque muestra algo importante sobre un estilo de vida sano. Además, me gustaría participar porque sería una experiencia útil y memorable.

(English: In the photo I can see young people preparing a colourful salad in a kitchen. The people seem focused and in good spirits. In my opinion, this situation is positive because it shows something important about the topic. I would also like to take part because it would be useful and memorable.)

questions.examTip: Cover all bullets and keep speaking; an opinion plus reason is better than a long but unfinished sentence.
questions.modelAnswer:
— Suelo desayunar yogur con fruta y bebo agua durante el día. A mi modo de ver es importante porque tiene ventajas para mí y para otras personas. — (Unexpected question) Cuando estoy estresado, paseo al aire libre y respiro lentamente.

(English: — I usually have yoghurt with fruit for breakfast and drink water during the day. In my view it is important because it has benefits for me and other people. — When I am stressed, I walk outdoors and breathe slowly.)
questions.question: Role-play: your teacher plays a Spanish friend. Talk about un estilo de vida sano. You must: (1) say what you normally do or prefer, (2) explain your opinion and a reason, and (3) respond to the unexpected question: “What happened recently?”

questions.examTip: Cover all bullets and keep speaking; an opinion plus reason is better than a long but unfinished sentence.
questions.modelAnswer:
— Juego al baloncesto tres veces a la semana para estar en forma. A mi modo de ver es importante porque tiene ventajas para mí y para otras personas. — (Unexpected question) El médico me recomendó que hiciera ejercicio con más frecuencia.

(English: — I play basketball three times a week to keep fit. In my view it is important because it has benefits for me and other people. — The doctor recommended that I exercise more often.)
questions.question: Role-play: your teacher plays a Spanish friend. Talk about un estilo de vida sano. You must: (1) describe a recent experience, (2) explain your opinion and a reason, and (3) respond to the unexpected question: “Why is that useful?”

questions.examTip: Cover all bullets and keep speaking; an opinion plus reason is better than a long but unfinished sentence.

— Antes comía demasiados dulces, pero ahora evito el azúcar. A mi modo de ver es importante porque tiene ventajas para mí y para otras personas. — (Unexpected question) No quiero beber alcohol porque puede ser peligroso para los jóvenes.

(English: — I used to eat too many sweets, but now I avoid sugar. In my view it is important because it has benefits for me and other people. — I do not want to drink alcohol because it can be dangerous for young people.)
